description: If a relation assigns exactly one output to every member of A, its restricted collection of input-output Kuratowski pairs is a set.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.AxiomaticSetTheory.replacement_restricted_graph.{u} (A : ZFSet.{u}) (R : ZFSet.{u} → ZFSet.{u} → Prop)
  (hR : ∀ x ∈ A, ∃! y, R x y) : ∃ G, ∀ (z : ZFSet.{u}), z ∈ G ↔ ∃ x ∈ A, ∃ y, R x y ∧ z = x.pair y
